repo_notes.content: ashlr-plugin is a multi-host coding-agent efficiency layer. Use README.md, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and site/content/docs/ as the public documentation; docs/ contains contributor notes unless linked from a public page. Ground descriptions in the current source and avoid inventing benchmark results.

The MCP router and tool implementations live in servers/; CLI entry points live in scripts/; hooks/, commands/, agents/, skills/, and ports/ provide host integrations. server/, site/, and vscode/ are distinct supporting applications.

pages.title: Overview and Installation
pages.purpose: Explain what ashlr-plugin does, its supported hosts, installation, and the public documentation entry points.

pages.title: MCP Router and Tools
pages.purpose: Trace MCP startup and tool registration through servers/_router.ts and explain the file, search, edit, shell, and other tool implementations in servers/.

pages.title: CLI and Host Integrations
pages.purpose: Describe the CLI in scripts/ and how ports/, hooks/, commands/, agents/, and skills/ integrate with coding-agent hosts.

pages.title: Savings and Privacy
pages.purpose: Explain local savings accounting, opt-in telemetry, project-root boundaries, and benchmark methodology using the current implementation and public documentation.

pages.title: Supporting Applications and Development
pages.purpose: Orient contributors to server/, site/, vscode/, tests, and the repository's development and validation commands.
